title: handle_changes maps TooManyChanges to non-RFC error
description: crate-jmap-server handle_changes maps BackendChangesError::TooManyChanges to the tooManyChanges error. RFC 8620 §5.2 (rfc8620.txt L1822-1829) lists only cannotCalculateChanges for Foo/changes; tooManyChanges is §5.6 queryChanges-only (L2810). Over maxChanges, /changes should return a partial result with hasMoreChanges=true. Decide: map to serverFail/cannotCalculateChanges, or split the error type so /changes backends cannot produce it. Found in review of JMAP-w8fu.17; behavior predates it.
